entities.name: UniProt:B0USS1
observations: Exact 223-aa sequence match to reviewed Histophilus somni ribonuclease III (RNase III).
Annotated as a Mg2+-dependent endoribonuclease (EC 3.1.26.3) that cleaves double-stranded RNA and participates in rRNA and RNA processing; cytoplasmic homodimer.
Sequence-derived estimates: 25.23 kDa, pI 8.72; estimates do not account for modifications or bound partners.
